attributes.name: Melazmera
attributes.powers:
Melazmera is immune to the Cold trait. During this encounter, you cannot succeed at checks to recharge spells.

Before you act, each character at a random occupied location must succeed at a Constitution or Fortitude 10 check. Characters who succeed expend 1 mythic charge; characters who fail expend 1d4 mythic charges.

If defeated, you may shuffle Melazmera into a random other open location to immediately attempt to close your location.
